params.body:
The AI tools page showed six cards of equal weight, each with a command to copy. A reader had to find their tool in a grid of commands, and the people most likely to want Gentells (brand and strategy teams on Claude or ChatGPT) are not the ones who copy commands.

**One tab per tool, with one button that does it**
- **Tabs:** Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex. The chat apps come first. The open tab sits in the URL hash, so `/connect#chatgpt` links straight to it.
- **Add to Claude:** opens claude.ai's "Add custom connector" form with Gentells and the address filled in. Other MCP servers use the same link (`?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=…&connectorUrl=…`), but Anthropic has not documented it. The address to paste therefore stays beside the button, with the manual step.
- **Add to VS Code** (`vscode:mcp/install?…`) is new. **Add to Cursor** stays.
- **ChatGPT** still needs developer mode for a server outside its app directory. Its tab says so and points business users to their admin.

**For your IT team** (`/connect#it`)

On Claude Team and Enterprise only an owner can add a connector. On ChatGPT Business and Enterprise an admin publishes apps for the workspace. A new section gives each of them three steps, plus the facts an admin asks for: a remote MCP server with OAuth, read-only, and each person signs in with their own account. A reader can forward it.

**Not tested end to end:** the Claude link against claude.ai, and the VS Code link in VS Code. Both are built to their documented or observed formats. The copy fallback covers both.

Tests: 366 passing. Screenshots taken locally.

Next: submission to the Claude Connectors Directory and the ChatGPT App Directory, which is the real one-click path for non-technical users.
params.title: AI tools: one tab per tool with one button, and the steps for IT
